diversification.vide: Add accounts to get diversification suggestions.
diversification.disclaimer: These suggestions are generated automatically by simple rules applied to your own data; they do not constitute investment advice or a personalized recommendation under financial regulation, and do not come from a licensed advisor. The risk profile below is a preference you declare yourself, not the result of a suitability assessment. Investing carries a risk of capital loss — consult a professional before making any decision.
diversification.hors_modele: Real estate and unclassified accounts ({{amount}}) are not included in this model.
diversification.type_concentration: {{pct}} of your net worth is concentrated in {{type}} accounts.
diversification.type_concentration_why: Heavy reliance on a single account type can restrict tax flexibility and heighten regulatory or account limit risks.
diversification.type_concentration_action: Consider diversifying future contributions across complementary wrappers (PEA, life insurance, cash accounts) to spread tax perks and liquidity horizons.
diversification.holding_concentration: "{{name}}" alone makes up {{pct}} of your total net worth.
diversification.holding_concentration_why: High single-asset exposure concentrates your portfolio to company-specific idiosyncratic risk.
diversification.holding_concentration_action: To mitigate this risk without triggering immediate sales, direct upcoming savings into index funds or other asset classes.
diversification.overlap_obs: "{{company}}" appears across {{count}} of your funds ({{funds}}), totaling {{amount}} ({{pct}} of your equities).
diversification.overlap_why: Combining several broad index funds (e.g. MSCI World and S&P 500) often duplicates the same mega-caps without genuine additional diversification.
diversification.overlap_action: Before adding a new fund, inspect its top 10 holdings to ensure it offers real complementary exposure (small caps, emerging markets, etc.).
diversification.fees_obs: Your estimated average annual fees are {{avgPct}} (approx. {{annualCost}}/year). Most expensive holding: {{expensiveName}} ({{expensivePct}}).
diversification.fees_why: A 1% annual fee gap compound-reduces your portfolio terminal value by nearly 18% over a 20-year horizon.
diversification.fees_action: Check if lower-cost index funds / ETFs (0.15% to 0.35%) can effectively replace active funds charging above 1% to 1.5% annually.
diversification.pea_missing_title: Open a PEA to start the clock
diversification.pea_missing_obs: You hold investment assets without an active PEA account.
diversification.pea_missing_why: The French PEA offers full income tax exemption on capital gains after 5 years (only 17.2% social contributions apply).
diversification.pea_missing_action: Open a PEA promptly, even with a minimal initial deposit (€10 to €100), to trigger the 5-year tax clock.
diversification.pea_no_date_obs: Your PEA account "{{name}}" has no recorded tax opening date.
diversification.pea_no_date_why: The 5-year milestone is crucial: withdrawals before 5 years close the plan; withdrawals after 5 years are tax-exempt and leave the account open.
diversification.pea_no_date_action: Edit this account to record its tax opening date and unlock accurate milestone tracking.
diversification.pea_under_5_obs: Your PEA is {{duration}} old. {{remaining}} remaining until the 5-year milestone.
diversification.pea_under_5_why: Any withdrawal prior to 5 years generally triggers automatic account closure and full taxation (30% flat tax).
diversification.pea_under_5_action: Refrain from withdrawals until the 5th anniversary, using cash savings accounts for unforeseen expenses.
diversification.pea_mature_title: PEA mature (≥ 5 years): Tax exemption unlocked
diversification.pea_mature_obs: Your PEA has reached full tax maturity (held for {{duration}}).
diversification.pea_mature_why: Partial withdrawals are now completely exempt from income tax (17.2% social charges only) and do not close your plan.
diversification.pea_mature_action: You can freely contribute and withdraw as needed, up to the legal contribution ceiling of €150,000.
diversification.pea_ceiling_obs: Your PEA is valued at {{amount}}, approaching or exceeding the legal contribution limit.
diversification.pea_ceiling_why: The legal deposit cap is €150,000 (portfolio valuation with gains can exceed this cap without penalty).
diversification.pea_ceiling_action: Once your deposit cap is reached, consider opening a PEA-PME (€225,000 combined limit) or directing new funds to an Assurance-Vie or brokerage account.
diversification.av_missing_obs: You do not have a French life insurance (Assurance-Vie) contract recorded.
diversification.av_missing_why: Assurance-Vie provides an annual tax allowance of €4,600 (€9,200 for couples) on capital gains after 8 years, plus €152,500 estate tax exemption per beneficiary.
diversification.av_missing_action: Even with a modest amount, opening a no-entry-fee contract starts the beneficial 8-year tax timeline.
diversification.av_no_date_obs: The contract "{{name}}" has no recorded tax opening date.
diversification.av_no_date_why: The 8-year milestone determines when annual capital gains tax allowances become available on partial surrenders.
diversification.av_no_date_action: Record the opening date in account settings to activate duration and maturity calculations.
diversification.av_under_8_obs: Your contract is {{duration}} old ({{remaining}} remaining before reaching 8 years).
diversification.av_under_8_why: Before 8 years, withdrawals are subject to standard 30% flat tax without allowances. The tax regime becomes optimal after 8 years.
diversification.av_under_8_action: Favor liquid cash accounts for short-term needs to allow your contract to mature past the 8-year mark.
diversification.av_mature_title: Assurance-Vie mature (≥ 8 years): Annual allowance active
diversification.av_mature_obs: Your contract has surpassed 8 years of holding ({{duration}}).
diversification.av_mature_why: You now qualify for the annual tax allowance on gains (€4,600 single, €9,200 married), enabling income-tax-free withdrawals.
diversification.av_mature_action: If you need cash, schedule annual partial withdrawals calibrated to make full use of this tax allowance every year.
diversification.av_fees_obs: Contract "{{name}}" carries {{mgmtPct}} management fees or {{entryPct}} entry fees.
diversification.av_fees_why: High contract fees steadily erode your net compound return year after year.
diversification.av_fees_action: Many modern online contracts feature 0% entry fees and 0.5%–0.6% unit-linked management fees. Check transfer options under the Pacte law.
diversification.idle_cash_obs: You hold {{amount}} in non-interest-bearing checking accounts (above the recommended {{threshold}}).
diversification.idle_cash_why: Uninvested cash in checking accounts generates zero yield and loses purchasing power to inflation.
diversification.idle_cash_action: Keep 1–2 months of living expenses in checking, and sweep the surplus to guaranteed, tax-free savings accounts (Livret A, LDDS).
diversification.horizon_short_obs: Your project "{{name}}" ({{amount}}) is due soon ({{deadline}}), but available liquid assets are below this target.
diversification.horizon_short_why: A temporary market decline close to your deadline could force you to liquidate equities at a loss.
diversification.horizon_short_action: Gradually de-risk necessary funds into capital-guaranteed instruments (savings accounts, euro funds, term deposits) as the deadline nears.
diversification.horizon_long_obs: {{pct}} of your wealth is held in cash or money-market assets, despite long-term objectives.
diversification.horizon_long_why: Over 8–10+ year horizons, cash yields typically lag inflation, eroding real purchasing power.
diversification.horizon_long_action: Depending on your risk tolerance, consider channeling part of regular contributions toward productive assets (global ETFs, equities, real estate).
diversification.crypto_exposure: Crypto assets make up {{pct}} of your total net worth.
diversification.crypto_exposure_why: Crypto assets exhibit extreme volatility and high potential for short-term capital drawdown.
diversification.crypto_exposure_action: Maintain a calibrated sizing (typically 2% to 10% depending on risk appetite) and rebalance during major bull runs.
diversification.illiquid_exposure: {{pct}} of your net worth is locked in illiquid holdings (real estate, pension schemes).
diversification.illiquid_exposure_why: These assets cannot be converted quickly into cash without delay, discount, or legal retirement triggers.
diversification.illiquid_exposure_action: Ensure an adequate liquid emergency buffer on accessible savings accounts before expanding illiquid positions.
diversification.currency_exposure: {{pct}} of your net worth is denominated in {{currency}}, outside the euro.
diversification.currency_exposure_why: Currency depreciation against the euro will directly reduce the converted value of your assets, irrespective of underlying asset performance.
diversification.currency_exposure_action: Verify that this currency exposure aligns with an intentional strategy and diversify if necessary.
diversification.cash_cushion_low: Your emergency fund only covers {{pct}} of your targeted goal.
diversification.cash_cushion_low_why: Without an adequate cash buffer, unexpected life events can force costly borrowing or unfavorable asset liquidations.
diversification.cash_cushion_low_action: Prioritize funding accessible savings accounts until you reach 3 to 6 months of living expenses.
diversification.cash_cushion_high: Your cash buffer significantly exceeds your target ({{pct}} of goal).
diversification.cash_cushion_high_why: Surplus cash held beyond emergency requirements incurs market opportunity costs and inflation erosion.
diversification.cash_cushion_high_action: Consider dollar-cost averaging the excess cash into long-term investments (PEA, life insurance).
diversification.allocation_gap_over: You're at {{actualPct}} in {{bucket}}, above this profile's {{targetPct}} target.
diversification.allocation_gap_under: You're at {{actualPct}} in {{bucket}}, below this profile's {{targetPct}} target.
diversification.allocation_gap_why: Sustained allocation drift from your target increases risk exposure or diminishes expected return.
diversification.allocation_gap_over_action: Rebalance through new cash flows: rather than selling assets (which incurs taxes and fees), steer upcoming contributions into under-weighted buckets.
diversification.allocation_gap_under_action: To steadily build up this bucket without market-timing, consider scheduled recurring purchases (DCA).
diversification.sector_concentration: {{pct}} of your classified holdings ({{coverage}} of the classifiable total) are in the {{sector}} sector.
diversification.sector_concentration_why: Over-weighting a single sector magnifies sensitivity to industry-specific economic and regulatory shocks.
diversification.sector_concentration_action: When adding new positions, explore under-represented sectors (healthcare, consumer staples, industrials) to improve balance.
diversification.geo_concentration: {{pct}} of your classified holdings ({{coverage}} of the classifiable total) are exposed to: {{country}}.
diversification.geo_concentration_why: Concentrating assets in a single nation links your capital to that country's specific macroeconomic and regulatory health.
diversification.geo_concentration_action: Broaden your geographic exposure through multi-region or global indices to spread sovereign and regional risks.
diversification.balanced_obs: Your net worth looks well spread across account types, assets and currencies.
diversification.balanced_why: Broad diversification helps navigate market cycles with controlled overall volatility.
diversification.balanced_action: Keep up your regular contributions and periodically verify alignment with your long-term life goals.

Enable Banking (free, personal use) covers checking accounts via PSD2: French banks, and Revolut via Lithuania. PEA, brokerage, and life insurance accounts aren't covered by banking APIs: track them manually with automatic prices.

Trade Republic uses an unofficial API (Android only, 2FA on every sync).

ebConnect.intro:
Enable Banking gives free access (personal use, "restricted production") to your banks' payment accounts via PSD2.

1. Create an account on enablebanking.com then an application (Production environment).
2. Enable Banking only accepts https redirect URLs: register the address of the bounce page there (the project's docs/eb-callback.html file, deployed via GitHub Pages), or any https URL otherwise — you'll then paste the return URL by hand after approving at the bank.
3. Paste the Application ID, the PEM private key, and that same https URL here.
ebConnect.redirect_url_hint: Must match the URL registered in the Enable Banking application.
ebConnect.private_key_hint: Stored encrypted on the device (Android Keystore). Only used to sign requests to api.enablebanking.com.
ebConnect.pays_hint: Revolut connects via Lithuania; Fortuneo and BoursoBank via France.
ebConnect.url_recue_hint: If the automatic return didn't work: copy the full URL of the page reached after approving at the bank (it contains ?code=…) and paste it here.
